rv.q: The verdict, therefore, remains out as to both the depth of his performance and the pacing of the show in general.
Susan Charlotte's adaptation does not do the material justice.
There’s very little here to justify yet another look at Bruce’s downfall, much less to demonstrate what a great standup we lost thereby.
Unfortunately, The People Versus Lenny Bruce lets our minds wander, so we notice.

cn.t: Critics find this courtroom drama about Lenny Bruce's obscenity trial muddled and blandly directed, though the subject matter of free speech and comedy remains compelling. Reception is mixed to negative overall.
